verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents that LoRA adapters stay unmerged, so one read-only base serves multiple adapter sets. Upgrading swaps only adapter files, and serving runs through an OpenAI-compatible `edge0 serve` endpoint. The evidence does not show how multiple adapters are selected or served together at runtime, and the shipped adapters are tied to quantization recovery rather than arbitrary user LoRAs. Missing for 10: per-request adapter selection in the serve API, concurrent or batched multi-adapter serving, loading custom user LoRAs, efficiency benchmarks for multi-adapter serving, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model

citations.quote: Adapters stay unmerged: one read-only base serves multiple adapter sets.
upgrading adapters swaps adapter files only — the base stays read-only and is never merged.
